title: Automatic Engram retries spin on a paused receipted head that only an explicit Resume can start
outcome: Automatic Engram retries spin on a paused receipted head that only an explicit Resume can start
acceptance: An automatic Engram retry (admission, bind or abort) that meets a receipted head that is Pending on a paused queue is dropped or held explicitly, with no retry slot taken and no begin-preparation attempt counted on later ticks, and the preview says the head waits for an explicit Resume. An end-to-end test of a bind-retry or admission-retry park on a receipted head followed by Resume shows the prompt sent once.
